generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular agency/firm/contractor, who have carried out similar nature of work in any Dam/ power utilities in Karnataka or any other states. As a proof bidder shall furnish at least one scanned copy of single work order and work done certificate of value not less than Rs. 7.11Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) issued by competent authority for the work carried out during any one year within last five financial years. If the tenderer is from any other state, license shall be endorsed by the competent authority of Karnataka.

itemList.description: Supply, fabrication & fixing of control panel/tap off unit, Made with 2.00mm sheet body & door with1.6mm sheet thick CR sheet Panel shall be constructed over a C-channel all round at the bottom facing outward. Having : 4Nos. 240/24V or 415/24V, 1.5KVA AC epoxy dipped transformer, with a 4 Pole 32A MCB Main incomer, double pole 6A control MCB for transformer incomer placed in separate chamber with hinged doors and Four feeders with 16A double pole MCB with extended door mounted handle and HRC fuse cut-out/MCB with LED type indicating lamps for ON/OFF/TRIP, feeder wiring shall be 10sqmm PVC insulated copper. PVC insulated copper cable in separate chamber with hinged doors. All earth point like doors, components, transformers etc., Shall be looped using copper conductor to a copper strip placed at the bottom of the panel. Incomer/outgoing supply shall be controlled by an MCB & fuse unitMCB. LED type indicators for ON/OFF/TRIP, supply healthy shall be provided for all. Sufficient number space heaters shall be provided at the bottom of the panel. Panel protection rating IP55. Panel size: 1000MM(H)X1250MM(W)X500MM(D) with 30cm four legged 50mm angle stand including anchoring. Spare: 2Nos transformers. approval shall be obtained before supplying panel by EE(O&M)MANI.

Lamp fitting shall be fixed on surface as directed by work in charge by using rawlplugs & SS bolts. Protection Rating: IP-68
